title: Intro: Why validation comes before training
text: Hi, this is Swara. And for this week's update on the National Loon Center project, I continued evaluating CVAT as our annotation platform. Since we do not have enough loon footage yet, the focus was validating the workflow before the real drone data arrives. The main idea this week was validation, not training.
